Nevus depigmentosus: F8: Histopathologic findings: plate-like subepidermal tumor extending horizontally under epidermis with multiple cord-like connections to overlying epidermis
F9: Neoplastic cords consisted of clear/pale epithelial cells with cytoplasm showing strong periodic acid-Schiff staining due to glycogen accumulation
F3: Lesion characteristics: round, hypopigmented macules
F4: Lesion distribution: symmetrically distributed on face and neck
F6: Absence of hair growth at the site of the lesions
